question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. S has an exam on Tuesday. Exactly two people have an exam between S and P. T has an exam immediately before U and R has an exam immediately after Q. Only 1 person has an exam between U and Q. How many people have exams after Q?
solution:
• Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.
 
• S has an exam on Tuesday. Exactly two people have an exam between S and P.
 
• T has an exam immediately before U, and R has an exam immediately after Q.
 
• Only 1 person has an exam between U and Q

The final arrangement is:

 
 

 
 
Monday

 
 
 
V

 
 
 

 
 
Tuesday</p&g
